name: Krosan Forest
description: A forest whose residents are mutated and grown gigantic by the Mirari's power.

description_citations.text: "Onslaught". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The land drinks power from the Mirari, transforming the Krosan Forest.
timeline.quote: The Mirari's magic transformed the Krosan Forest—and its inhabitants.

citation.text: Sudden Strength (Judgment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Silvos is born of the Mirari and thrust out of his homeland, finding purpose in the pits.
timeline.quote: He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware.

citation.text: Silvos, Rogue Elemental (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Mirari calls to the centaurs, changing all who heard it.
timeline.quote: The Mirari called to the centaurs, and all who heard it were forever changed.

citation.text: Centaur Glade (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kamahl leaves his violent former life behind.
timeline.quote: Kamahl left the violence of his former life behind him

citation.text: Tribal Unity (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Krosa unleashes peace in Kamahl and Kamahl unleashes fury in Krosa.
timeline.quote: As Krosa unleashed the peace in Kamahl, he unleashed the fury in Krosa.

citation.text: Kamahl's Summons (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After politics and war, the Mirari, attached to Kamahl's sword, is implanted through Laquatus's corpse into the Krosan Forest, channeling its magic into the land.
timeline.quote: is implanted through the corpse of Laquatus and into the Krosan Forest

citation.text: "Judgment", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the forest's edge Balthor holds off the pursuers and unleashes a great spell that kills himself and Burke; Laquatus discovers his troops were wiped out by Llawan's and forges a flimsy alliance with the Cabal and Order.
timeline.quote: the dwarf unleashes a great spell that kills them both.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Seton agrees to cure Jeska and sends Kamahl to Thriss, who helps him control his strength and desires and commune with nature.
timeline.quote: gives him substantial help in controlling his strength and desires and makes him able to communicate with nature.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An unknown assailant attacks the camps in the forest and the Order leader is killed, blamed on the Cabal, which leaves.
timeline.quote: An unknown assailant begins to attack the camps, and the Order leader is killed, but the blame is given to the Cabal.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eesha, Braids and Llawan's envoys reveal Laquatus's plotting and abandon the quest for the Mirari, leaving him without support.
timeline.quote: They decide to leave the former ambassador to his own devices and abandon the quest for the Mirari.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl discovers the assailant is Balthor, zombified by Braids, and ends his undeath in tears.
timeline.quote: he is Balthor, zombified by Braids and instructed to kill Laquatus.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl kills Laquatus with the Mirari sword, its power now bringing growth and peace, and the forest is rejuvenated.
timeline.quote: The merman dies pinned by the sword.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl relocates to the Krosan Forest with the Mirari and becomes a druid of Krosa.
timeline.quote: Kamahl has relocated to the Krosan Forest with the Mirari and becomes a druid of Krosa.

citation.text: "Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Mirari's power begins mutating the forest's residents, growing some to gigantic proportions.
timeline.quote: The power of the Mirari begins to work on the forest, mutating its residents and growing some of them to gigantic proportions.

citation.text: "Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
